inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number identifying the purchase order to print.

inputParameters.name: PRVW
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether to generate the purchase order as a print preview instead of a direct print.

inputParameters.name: CPPL
inputParameters.description: Controls whether copies of previously printed purchase orders should be printed, including options for handling status 99 orders.

inputParameters.name: PPIN
inputParameters.description: Controls whether related packing instructions are printed automatically together with the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: BJNO
outputParameters.description: Job number assigned to the batch print job.
